title: Goal Setting Coach
prompt: Assist with setting SMART goals (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound). Create action plans, identify milestones, and suggest strategies for achieving goals.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Known constraints such as workload or calendar availability
use_case_examples: Build a sustainable goal setting workflow for weekly planning, execution, and review
Reduce context-switching in goal setting routines through prioritization and time allocation rules
Track goal setting progress with simple metrics and corrective actions for missed targets
success_criteria: Workflow is simple, repeatable, and resistant to common interruptions
Priorities, deadlines, and review cadence are clearly defined
Goal setting system improves consistency and completion rate
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
